claim: Transport every literal integral bicanonical chart formula through the actual rational model comparison, retaining signed coordinates, inverse twists and J-squared; glue these actual sections in the original intrinsic bicanonical sheaf and prove their global identity with J-squared times the original q0 and q1.

obligations.name: Actual objects
obligations.required_input: Consume the genuine intrinsic tensor-square sheaf and original global q0/q1.
obligations.constructed_input: The target is ContactGlobalBicanonical.tensor on ContactGlobalSmooth.Model. weightedSquare uses the genuine original relative differential sheaf. The final equality names the original q0 and q1.
obligations.justification: The target is ContactGlobalBicanonical.tensor on ContactGlobalSmooth.Model. weightedSquare uses the genuine original relative differential sheaf. The final equality names the original q0 and q1.

obligations.name: Full index coverage
obligations.required_input: Track every finite contact, infinity, and both sections.
obligations.constructed_input: Fin4 finite indices, the actual infinity chart and Fin2 sections are quantified. The final gluing uses the entire original Option(Fin4) cover and its already established coverage.
obligations.justification: Fin4 finite indices, the actual infinity chart and Fin2 sections are quantified. The final gluing uses the entire original Option(Fin4) cover and its already established coverage.

obligations.name: Signs and scalar factors
obligations.required_input: Root signs, universal differentials and J² cannot be inferred from squared relations alone.
obligations.constructed_input: Each branch coordinate maps to the same signed original root; u remains c0/y0. Actual AlgHomDifferential.map_D transports each differential. The integer scalar lemma retains J² on the true ambient module.

obligations.name: Transition maps
obligations.required_input: Use the same global scheme isomorphism and full chart routes.
obligations.constructed_input: All four branch routes are computed from the original source/localization algebra maps; the actual infinity route is inherited from originalModelIso. Both structure morphisms are equal to the original Q structure on each chart.

obligations.name: Actual section compatibility
obligations.required_input: Matching coefficient fractions is insufficient; compare actual sheaf sections on full chart images.
obligations.constructed_input: weightedSquare_restrict_to supplies naturality for both factors and the coefficient on the exact scheme routes. This proves each transported integral formula equals the restriction of J² times the original global section on the complete original chart.

obligations.name: Global identity
obligations.required_input: A generic-point or local existence statement cannot replace a full global comparison.
obligations.constructed_input: All five transported formulas are glued as actual sections inside the original tensor sheaf. The unique-gluing theorem on the complete original cover proves the resulting global section is exactly J²*q_n.
